n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: Oh, it's you, love. I'm afraid I've come down with the flu. Would you mind closing that window?

translations.fa: آه، تویی عزیزم. متأسفانه آنفلوآنزا گرفتم. اشکالی نداره اون پنجره را ببندی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course not. Shall I get you another blanket too?
branches.suggestionFa: معلومه که نه. یه پتوی دیگه هم بیارم؟

branches.suggestion: No problem. How long have you been feeling like this?
branches.suggestionFa: مشکلی نیست. چند وقته این‌طوری هستید؟

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: Since Tuesday. George has been an angel, but he can't cook. Would you mind making some soup?

translations.fa: از سه‌شنبه. ویلیام فرشته بوده، ولی آشپزی بلد نیست. اشکالی نداره یه سوپ درست کنی؟

branches.suggestion: I'd be happy to. What kind would you like?
branches.suggestionFa: با کمال میل. چه نوعی دوست دارید؟

branches.suggestion: Shall I make my mum's chicken soup?
branches.suggestionFa: سوپ مرغ مامانم را درست کنم؟

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: Ooh, that would be wonderful. And could you possibly ring the surgery for me? I've got an appointment I can't make.

translations.fa: اوه، عالی میشه. و ممکنه به مطب زنگ بزنی؟ یه وقت دارم که نمی‌تونم برم.

branches.suggestion: Of course. Shall I ask them to rebook it?
Would you like me to ask for a home visit?

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Rebooking is fine — next week, if they can. I don't want to be any trouble.

translations.fa: دوباره وقت گرفتن خوبه — هفتهٔ بعد، اگه بشه. نمی‌خوام زحمت بدم.

branches.suggestion: You're no trouble at all, Maggie.
Don't worry. You've looked after me so much.
branches.suggestionFa: نگران نباشید. شما خیلی از من مراقبت کردید.

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: You're a treasure. Would you mind passing my glasses? I want to finish my crossword before I nod off.

translations.fa: تو گنجی. اشکالی نداره عینکم را بدی؟ می‌خوام قبل از چرت زدن جدولم را تموم کنم.

branches.suggestion: Here you are. Do you want help with it?
Shall I read the clues to you?

cultureNote.en: "You're a treasure" or "you're a star" are warm British ways to say thank you.
cultureNote.fa: you're a treasure یعنی خیلی ممنونم.

n6.speaker: weda
n6.text: Go on then. Seven across: "a hot drink, three letters". Even I know that one — tea!

translations.fa: خب بخون. افقی هفت: «یه نوشیدنی داغ، سه حرف». اینو حتی من می‌دونم — چای!
